title: Monorepo Bootstrap, MIT License Gate & Graphify Initialization
description: Verify MIT LICENSE at repo root (Official Rules §6 gate), Docker Compose for PostgreSQL 16 + Valkey/Redis, and Graphify knowledge graph in .planning/graphs/.
steps: Verify LICENSE file exists at repo root with standard MIT text
Verify docker-compose.yml defines postgres:16-alpine and valkey/valkey:7.2-alpine with healthchecks
Verify .planning/config.json has graphify.enabled = true and .planning/graphs/graph.json is populated
pass: LICENSE file exists and is non-empty
docker-compose.yml and render.yaml pass syntax check
